SEO Packages

SEO, AI & Digital Marketing Packages for Business Growth

In today’s digital world, simply having a website is not enough. Businesses must appear on the first page of Google and Google Maps to attract customers and generate consistent leads. Our SEO and digital marketing packages are designed to help businesses improve online visibility, increase website traffic, and convert visitors into customers.

Whether you run a medical clinic, dental office, law firm, service company, or local business, our SEO strategies focus on improving your presence across Google Search, Google Maps, social media, and content marketing platforms.

Our packages are structured to fit businesses at different stages of growth—from basic website maintenance to aggressive SEO strategies targeting the top positions on Google.

Recovery to protect your traffic, visibility, and business.

DIGITAL MARKETING

SEO Pricing & Registration

If your business wants to rank higher on Google, attract more customers, and grow online visibility, our SEO packages provide a structured approach to digital marketing success.

Basic Website Maintenance & Marketing Package

Includes:

• Website maintenance and technical support
• Basic on-page SEO optimization (meta titles, descriptions, headings)
• Local SEO setup and optimization for 5–10 keywords
• Google My Business basic optimization (1–2 updates per week)
• 3 Facebook posts per month
• 1 SEO blog per month
• Blog indexing and search engine submission
• Free consultation for Google Ads and Facebook ads
• Any additional Google My Business page optimization – $250 per month
• Google Ads monitoring and management – $250 per month (additional)

This package is designed for businesses that want to maintain their website and gradually build online visibility.

Best For:
Small businesses that want consistent website updates and content growth.

Best for Established Business

Register

Basic SEO Growth Package

Includes:

• Website maintenance and technical support
• On-page SEO and technical SEO improvements
• Local SEO optimization for 10–20 keywords
• Google My Business optimization (3 days per week)
• 2 SEO blogs per month
• Blog indexing and search engine submission
• 4 Facebook posts per month
• AI search optimization
• Target: 5 valuable keywords within Top 5 on Google Search in the target location
• Target: 10 related keywords within Top 5 in AI search results within the location
• SEO monitoring and ranking improvements
• Free consultation for Google Ads and Facebook campaigns

This package includes website maintenance plus local SEO optimization to help your business appear on the first page of Google within a specific location.

Best For:
Businesses that want to improve local Google ranking and Google Maps visibility.

Best for Starter Business

Register

Advanced SEO & Digital Marketing Package

Includes:

• 24/7 support for hacked website repair, backups, and downtime assistance to ensure minimal or zero downtime
• Website maintenance and technical support
• Google My Business optimization (3–4 days per week)
• Additional location Google My Business optimization – $250 per location
• Local SEO and keyword ranking optimization
• AI search optimization
• Target: Achieve Top 5 rankings on Google’s first page, with Top 3 positions within the coverage area for primary valuable keywords, and Top 5 visibility for 20 related keywords in AI-powered search results
• 3 SEO blogs per month
• Blog indexing and search engine submission
• Social media posting: 4 Facebook, 2 Instagram, and 2 LinkedIn posts per month
• SEO monitoring and continuous ranking improvements
• Google Ads / PPC campaign management – $250 per month (additional)
• Free consultation and support for Facebook advertising campaigns
• Free consultation for Google PPC campaigns
• 1 press release every 3 months

This package is designed for businesses that want aggressive SEO growth, stronger Google visibility, and consistent marketing support.

Ideal For:

• Medical clinics
• Healthcare providers
• Law firms
• Service-based businesses
• Companies targeting competitive keywords

Register

Info

Why SEO Pricing Varies

Many business owners ask why SEO packages differ in price. SEO is not a one-size-fits-all service. The cost varies depending on several factors.

Get In Touch
+ Keyword Competition

Some keywords are extremely competitive. For example, ranking for “Emergency Room Houston” or “Dental Implants Houston” requires significantly more work than ranking for a smaller local term.

+ Market Size

Businesses in larger cities such as Houston, Dallas, Los Angeles, or Chicago require more SEO effort due to competition.

+ Number of Keywords

he more keywords you want to rank for, the more optimization work is required.

+ Google Business Profile Management

Frequent optimization of Google My Business (Google Maps) improves local rankings but requires consistent updates, monitoring, and posting.

+ Content Creation

Blogs, articles, and press releases help build authority and improve rankings, but they require research and professional writing.

+ Technical SEO Work

Fixing website errors, improving speed, optimizing pages, and maintaining security are part of technical SEO services.

Info

Frequently Asked Questions

Smart SEO Strategies, Not One-Size-Fits-All Solutions.

Get In Touch
+ What Is Required From the Business Owner

To achieve the best SEO results, some information and cooperation from the business owner is helpful.

Business Information

Business details such as services, service areas, and target keywords help build an effective SEO strategy.

Access to Website

We may require limited administrative access to the website to optimize pages and fix technical issues.

Google Business Profile Access

For local SEO and map optimization, access to the Google Business Profile may be required.

Business Photos and Updates

New photos, services, or updates about your business help improve engagement and visibility.

+ How Long Does SEO Take to Show Results?

SEO is a long-term strategy. Depending on competition and website condition, results may begin appearing within 3 to 6 months. Highly competitive markets may take longer.

However, once rankings improve, SEO provides consistent organic traffic without paying for every click.

+ Why Businesses Invest in SEO

SEO is one of the most effective digital marketing strategies because it:

• Brings organic traffic from Google searches
• Helps customers find your business locally
• Builds trust and credibility online
• Generates leads without constant advertising costs
• Improves long-term business visibility

+ Can you guarantee the first position on Google?

No ethical SEO company can guarantee the exact #1 position because search rankings are controlled by Google’s algorithm. However, we use proven strategies to improve ranking and visibility.

+ Why is Google My Business optimization important?

Google Business Profile optimization helps your business appear in Google Maps and local search results, which often generate the highest number of calls and visits, about 30% business. 

+ Do I need SEO if I already run Google Ads?

Yes. Google Ads bring immediate traffic, while SEO builds long-term organic visibility. Both strategies work best together.

+ Do you provide support for Google Ads campaigns?

Yes. Advanced and Premium packages include free consultation and support for Google Ads campaigns, with optional management services available.

Partners

Why Clinics Need SEO Even If They Serve Locally?

Many clinic owners believe that because their patients mostly come from nearby neighborhoods, search engine optimization (SEO) may not be necessary. In reality, local healthcare searches are among the most competitive searches on Google.

Today, when someone experiences symptoms such as chest pain, fever, stomach pain, or dental emergencies, the first thing they often do is search online for nearby medical help. Searches like “clinic near me,” “primary care doctor near me,” “urgent care near me,” or “cardiologist in Houston” happen thousands of times every day.

If a clinic does not appear on the first page of Google or Google Maps, patients may never discover that clinic—even if it is located only a few blocks away.

Local SEO ensures that when people search for medical care in their area, your clinic appears among the first results they see.

Patients Search Online Before Visiting Clinics

Healthcare decisions are increasingly influenced by online search behavior. Patients often look for:

• Doctors near their location
• Clinic reviews and ratings
• Available services
• Office hours and directions
• Appointment booking options

When a clinic has strong SEO and an optimized Google Business Profile, it becomes easier for patients to find the clinic quickly and trust its credibility.

Local Competition Between Clinics Is Increasing

Even smaller cities can have dozens of clinics competing for the same patients. In larger cities such as Houston, Dallas, or Miami, the competition is even higher.

When multiple clinics offer similar services—such as primary care, urgent care, cardiology, or dental care—the clinics that appear first on Google typically receive the majority of patient inquiries.

SEO helps clinics compete by improving:

• Google search ranking
• Google Maps visibility
• Website authority
• Patient trust through informative content

Without proper SEO, a clinic may lose patients to competitors who simply appear higher in search results.

Google Maps Visibility Is Critical for Clinics

Most healthcare searches trigger a Google Maps listing, which displays three businesses at the top of the results.

These listings often generate the highest number of calls and appointment requests because they show:

• Business location
• Phone number
• Directions
• Reviews and ratings

Optimizing a Google Business Profile is therefore one of the most important parts of clinic SEO.

AI Search Is Changing How Patients Find Clinics

Search engines are evolving rapidly. Platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing AI, and voice search assistants are transforming how patients discover healthcare providers.

Instead of simply showing websites, AI systems now summarize information and recommend trusted sources.

Clinics that want to appear in these AI-generated recommendations need:

• Structured website content
• Clear service pages
• Helpful medical articles
• Frequently asked questions
• Strong website authority

This process is often referred to as AI optimization or AI-search readiness.

Clinics with well-structured content are more likely to be referenced by AI tools when patients ask questions such as:

“Where can I find a primary care doctor near me?”
“Which clinic treats stomach pain in Houston?”
“Best cardiologist near Sugar Land?”

Educational Medical Content Builds Trust

Publishing informative blog posts about common symptoms and treatments helps clinics in two ways.

First, it improves SEO visibility, because patients frequently search for health-related questions.

Second, it builds patient trust, because educational content shows the clinic’s expertise and commitment to patient care.

Examples of helpful topics include:

• Early signs of heart disease
• Causes of abdominal pain
• When to see a doctor for dizziness
• Symptoms that require urgent medical care

When patients find helpful answers on a clinic’s website, they are more likely to choose that clinic for treatment.

SEO Helps Clinics Reach Patients at the Right Time

One of the most powerful aspects of SEO is that it connects clinics with patients at the exact moment they need care.

For example, someone searching:

“Emergency clinic near me”
“doctor for severe headache”
“walk-in clinic open today”

is often looking for immediate medical help.

If your clinic appears at that moment, it can lead directly to new patient visits and appointments.

Clinics That Invest in SEO Build Long-Term Visibility

Unlike traditional advertising that stops when the budget runs out, SEO creates long-term online visibility.

A well-optimized website and Google Business Profile can continue attracting new patients for years.

This makes SEO one of the most cost-effective marketing strategies for healthcare providers.
